title: Figure 15: Titanium components used in hip joint replacement
description: Photograph of an assortment of metal hip implant parts, including long femoral stems, ball heads and modular neck pieces, laid on a white surface. Caption: "Figure 15. Various Titanium Components Used in Hip Joint Replacement." It illustrates the 'Titanium - Hip and Knee Joints' section, followed by text on bioceramics.
